'''Matt Lush''' played the [[2016 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-world-championships/ 2016 World Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref> [[Eric Berger]] named him among Texas's "big-time players" at the 1997 Texas regional.<ref name="ars">[https://arstechnica.com/gaming/2015/12/that-one-time-i-played-in-the-star-wars-card-game-world-championship/ That one time I played in the Star Wars card game world championship], Eric Berger, Ars Technica (5 December 2015). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009010838/https://arstechnica.com/gaming/2015/12/that-one-time-i-played-in-the-star-wars-card-game-world-championship/ Internet Archive]</ref>
